Brand and interface tokens for KingdomOps, the account and kingdom planner. Logos and brand colors come from the approved kit; everything else is generated from it with contrast checked (0 failures, see design/contrast-report.md).

LogoUse the dark version on dark grounds and the light version on light grounds. Never stretch, rotate or add bevels.
